theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (z e : Euclid P), ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ z e = 0 → (∀ φ : ℝ, ‖Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e‖ = 1) ∧ (∀ φ ψ : ℝ, ‖(Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e) - (Real.cos ψ • z + Real.sin ψ • e)‖ ≤ |φ - ψ|) ∧ ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖Real.sin φ • z - Real.cos φ • e‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ (Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e) (Real.sin φ • z - Real.cos φ • e) = 0 ∧ ∀ ψ : ℝ, Real.cos ψ • (Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e) + Real.sin ψ • (Real.sin φ • z - Real.cos φ • e) = Real.cos (φ - ψ) • z + Real.sin (φ - ψ) • e
